request.prompt:
Goods: Solid oak bed frame, queen size
Country of origin: VN

Chosen so far: 94 Furniture; bedding, mattresses, mattress supports, cushions and similar stuffed furnishings; lamps and lighting fittings, n.e.c.; illuminated signs, illuminated name-plates and the like; prefabricated buildings

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 9401: Seats (not those of heading no. 9402), whether or not convertible into beds and parts thereof
    contains 940141: Seats; convertible into beds of wood, other than garden seats or camping equipment
    contains 940169: Seats; with wooden frames, not upholstered, (excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture)
    contains 940161: Seats; with wooden frames, upholstered, (excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture)
    contains 940149: Seats; convertible into beds of other than wood, other than garden seats or camping equipment
    contains 940179: Seats; with metal frames, not upholstered, (excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture)
    contains 940159: Seats; of cane, osier or similar materials, other than bamboo or rattan
- 9404: Mattress supports; articles of bedding (e.g. mattresses, quilts, eiderdowns, cushions pouffes and pillows), fitted with springs or stuffed, whether or not covered
    contains 940490: Bedding and similar furnishing articles; n.e.c. in heading no. 9404 (e.g. quilts, eiderdowns, cushions, pouffes and pillows)
- 9402: Furniture; medical, surgical, dental or veterinary (e.g. operating tables, hospital beds, dentists' chairs) barbers' chairs; parts
    contains 940290: Furniture; for medical, surgical, veterinary use (e.g. operating tables, examination tables, hospital beds with mechanical fittings) and parts thereof
- 9403: Furniture and parts thereof, n.e.c. in chapter 94
    contains 940350: Furniture; wooden, for bedroom use
    contains 940389: Furniture; of cane, osier, or similar materials (other than bamboo or rattan)
    contains 940360: Furniture; wooden, other than for office, kitchen or bedroom use
    contains 940391: Furniture; parts, of wood

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: A wooden bed frame is bedroom furniture not covered by seats, mattress supports/bedding or medical furniture, so it falls in the residual furniture heading 9403 (subheading 940350 for wooden bedroom furniture).
